items.title: Welcome by the School Board President
Study Session on Distance Learning/In Person Learning

publicComments.name: Jackie Moore
publicComments.summary: A single mother and high-risk staff member expressed fear about being required to return in person, describing the personal and family dangers she faces if she contracts COVID-19.

publicComments.name: Indra Hernandez
publicComments.summary: A preschool staff member thanked the board for their work, asked that preschool be included in reopening pilots and the January 19th return date, and noted that classroom cleaning had been insufficient at her site.

publicComments.name: Michelle Smith
publicComments.summary: Expressed gratitude for the planning and protocols presented, raised concerns about classroom heat and air quality in spring, and asked that lower-resource school sites receive equitable support.

publicComments.name: Karla (Maestra)
publicComments.summary: Thanked the board and staff for their work, said her anxiety about returning had been alleviated, and emphasized the importance of prioritizing students' social-emotional stability and development.
